title: Native dashboard and administration
features: Review accounts, developers and registered apps in separate Administration cards.
Check server storage and open verified-app storage from the native app.
fixes: The account overview brings back the colored profile card, shortcut tiles and section dividers from the mobile website.

title: Mail setup and app approvals
features: Copy generated mail passwords and find mail-client setup in the inbox.
Manage private-app access from a searchable list. Administrators can verify developers directly.
fixes: Sign-in separates the developer from the account you’re using, suggests email code AutoFill where supported, and shows progress on the action you started.
Mail clients gain additional reconnect authentication support.

title: Private and self-hosted apps
features: Private apps support approved users and access requests. Local apps can register without DNS, with reader trust controls for shared data.
Use the Expo account overview for sign-in, profile, sync settings, and account management.
fixes: Fixed browser consent and stacked sidebar navigation, made linked emails read-only, and removed user-owned data on unlink.
Improved mail connection setup and reconnect limits.

title: Device sign-in and linked permissions
features: Sign in on another device with a QR code or short code.
Review and adjust app sign-in grants and confirm returning sign-ins.
User-owned records count toward account storage. Service databases have independent quotas.
Account activity emails use an HTML template. Developer profiles can link to GitHub.
fixes: Storage navigation returns to the appropriate developer or administrator page.

title: App trust and longer sign-ins
features: See verified and administrator badges across account and app views.
Apps can import accepted friends with app-specific identifiers and require optional claims during setup.
App sessions can renew for another 14 days during use.
fixes: App branding refreshes on the permissions page, verification actions appear only as needed, and offline dashboard navigation works.

title: App management and dashboard polish
features: Administrators can inspect volume health and app quotas. App owners and administrators can delete registrations.
Linked apps can retrieve the authorized profile and photo. The integration skill explains public, private, shared, and unsigned-client integration.
fixes: Improved small-screen layout, mail composer motion, controls, app links, and verification delivery.

title: Mail clients and private addresses
features: Connect mail apps over authenticated IMAP and SMTP. Create premium mailbox aliases and check the state of private addresses.
fixes: Validated the production email relay and improved address state feedback.

title: Hosted data and client integrations
features: Verified apps can manage encrypted hosted data, published data and user-approved cross-app sharing.
Published X-Center ID integration skill guidance and added authenticated inbound email verification.
Reorganized account management with an administrator workspace.
fixes: Improved admin access renewal, mail receiver error reporting and native build validation.

title: Account moderation and support
features: Administrators can lock accounts separately from signing out devices and approve username changes.
Send support requests and replies through the mailbox or delete selected messages together.
fixes: Updated native signing and verification workflow checks.

title: Friends and mail sharing
features: Share selected files and publisher-approved saved places with friends.
Manage private addresses, browse older messages, and read or compose mail on dedicated screens. Core mailbox actions support multiple languages.
fixes: Removed unlinked apps from the permission directory and improved Android package verification.

title: Native account management
features: Manage accounts in Expo and use a reusable registered sign-in entry.
Manage app linking and consent in the dashboard.
Read and clean up private mailbox messages.
fixes: Revoked unlinked grants, supported encrypted account renames, and improved signup, developer profiles and navigation.

title: X-Center ID sign-in and mail
features: OpenID Connect for registered apps, plus sample integrations.
Reserved mail identities and added authenticated mailbox submission.
Introduced a redesigned responsive account and sign-in experience.
fixes: Recorded web deployments and prepared parallel native previews.

title: Passwordless dashboard foundation
features: Added passkey accounts, registered confidential clients, a developer portal and a reusable native authorization helper.
Introduced encrypted account-scoped records and permission grants.
Built an Expo dashboard, native account tabs and offline web shell.
fixes: Disabled the legacy server by default and fixed exported font delivery.

title: Original AuthNJS
features: Original Node.js authentication API, account and app management, and administrative and developer pages.
